podcast.body: This album, released in 1997, was the second record by Ben Folds Five and achieved platinum certification. It features the song "The Battle of Who Could Care Less" and embodies Ben Folds' self-described "Punk Rock for Sissies" musical style. "This is from the second Ben Foltz Five record entitled, Whatever and Ever On Men. It's the Battle of Who Could Care Less. A platinum album, Ben Foltz Five, 1997."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
